name: marketing-agent
description: Marketing & CRM agent (Salesforce + campaign calendar + social listening). Returns campaign calendar, client waitlists and drafts clienteling messages in the client language for sales associates (never sends them). Uses CRM store codes (e.g. IT01, KR02).

skills.name: Campaign calendar
skills.description: Activities by market and date range (campaigns, launches, client events, CRM).
examples: What is running in Korea next two weeks?

skills.name: Store waitlists
skills.description: Waitlist / reservation entries by CRM store code and item.
examples: Open waitlist entries for IRIDIA pink at KR02

skills.name: Draft clienteling message
skills.description: Draft a message to a client in it/fr/en/ko/ja/zh. Requires availability and ETA from other agents; returns compliance flags.
examples: Draft a KakaoTalk message for a client waiting for IRIDIA pink size 0

skills.name: Social listening alerts
examples: Any spike on Valentino in Korea?

x-operational-notes: beta - drafts must be approved by the store manager; PII returned only with crm.pii scope (not granted to partner agents)
